overall: CRM defect retests and runtime smoke pass; broader backend schema governance still has two failing tests

newRegressionsFixedAndDeployed.issue: Deal/contact creation SQL parameter inference error (42P08)
newRegressionsFixedAndDeployed.fix: Explicit PostgreSQL parameter casts in INSERT SELECT

newRegressionsFixedAndDeployed.issue: CSV import parsed CSV as an XLSX ZIP archive
newRegressionsFixedAndDeployed.fix: Explicit CSV reader, preserved XLSX path, malformed upload 400

outstandingBackendChecks.failure: Email/underwriting routes retain runtime CREATE/ALTER DDL outside migrations.
Campaign route retains runtime schema DDL.

testBoundaries: Write, duplicate/concurrency, conversion, activity and import scenarios used disposable local PostgreSQL and real HTTP route handlers with synthetic authentication and external send/storage adapters disabled.
Live UI mutation requests were blocked; no production business fixtures were created.
No real emails, WhatsApp/SMS messages, social actions or phone calls were sent.
One canonical run overlapped the API reload and saw transient 502 responses. The final run after stable health returned GO.
Pass denotes the reported defect verified at the stated layer; it is not full external-provider acceptance.
